messages:
Maya Patel: Quick FYI — leadership summary for this Friday. TL;DR: on track for Private beta next month; SLOs are improving but unit cost is still above target. Key asks: 1) Dedicated: finalize burst policy + pricing by Tue; 2) Runtime: reduce chat p95 by ~20ms; 3) Product: finalize Private onboarding flow; 4) Finance: update Q2 forecast for Dedicated bookings. Metrics snapshot: MRR $1.9M (+7% w/w), Avg latency p95 210ms (-12ms), Platform availability 99.93% (30d), Unit cost /1k tokens $0.62. Please flag blockers. :rocket:

Alex Chen: On runtime — kernel rollout queued that should shave ~15ms on p95 but needs a longer canary. Plan: deploy to eu-west on Mon and monitor for 48h+; will need SRE support for increased tracing retention during canary.

Sofia Martinez: Product — onboarding checklist is done. Working on Private-only docs and the self-serve contract flow. Waiting on legal for an updated DPA clause (ETA Wed). If legal slips, we should prepare a guarded rollout path.

Liam O'Connor: Finance — I'll update the Q2 forecast with a conservative and stretch scenario. Expecting +$300k if two enterprise Dedicated deals close. Also proposing a focused infra cost-reduction challenge (top 3 levers) — will share a short doc by EOD Mon.

Jordan Kim: DevEx — I'll assemble a one-page runbook for Private installs and host office hours next Thursday. Quick ask: does Product have a customer-facing KMS checklist we can reuse? @Sofia

Marcus Vega: SRE — we can extend the canary to 72h for the kernel rollout if Alex signs off. Also seeing a small uptick in OOMs on a subset of 80G nodes; investigating memory growth in session GC. Nothing critical yet but tracking.

Maya Patel: Thanks — approve 72h canary, Alex. Sofia, please loop legal and draft a short customer note about Private beta expectations. Liam, pick the top 3 cost levers and we'll prioritize. Quick sync Monday 10am PT; if no blockers we'll ship the Private beta gating checklist. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Deploy started by alex on eu-west at 1826004900.

Alex Chen: Noted. Will post canary dashboard link when live and ping on the SRE channel.
